rules: Eager same-layer causal cuts are TP8 AllGather after attention mHC/norm, TP8 AllToAll after sparse MLA/send packing, TP8 ReduceScatter after OA/OB, then EP16 F21 entrance after FFN mHC/norm. Use the elapsed change in the latest participant entry at each cut, with original transfer duration and downstream skew. An all-empty DP omits AllToAll and keeps its other joins. Clock offsets come from the original F21/collective constraints. Per-cut interval extremes need not be simultaneously attainable. Aligned assumes zero relative clock shifts.

Per-rank selected MLA, OA and mHC stages have ordered, disjoint charged task intervals; never reuse their GEMM or MAC throughput concurrently at those sites. Q/K prework, nonselected attention, network service, FFN expert placement, graph slot service and prior QLI implementation are retained. Joint impacts are accumulated before each EP16 frontier and each client deadline; nearest-rank P90 of eight is the maximum. Credit previous scheduled waves under serial propagation. Stop at the request’s first scheduled large prefill with a target selection, or its last owning verification for makespan. A later launch before client flush gets no credit. Client TTFT mapping assumes the first prompt selection emits the first token.

HC prices 34 directly connected attention and 40 FFN sites. Preserve rounded four-way residual, FP32 workspace, coefficients, exact Y, RMS arithmetic and reader planes. A two-read case charges the specified surcharge on rewriting the FP32 workspace at the producer. Stage-level transfers are capped by existing Pre and norm durations in eager. No extra credit for an earlier Y schedule or separate F01 implementation.

SMLA uses an assumed count up to 512 valid selected positions at each of 38 eligible layers, a per-query BF16 row of width 512, original arithmetic order, QK and PV compute floors, unchanged index and KV generation. The tested relation describes logical GM accesses, not measured HBM misses or occupancy. OA retains the rounded BF16 intermediate through tile ownership and keeps its 1024-way OB dot, shared Cube capacity and L1-to-L0B weight floor. Common case uses 90% of both rates, 50% intra-pair overlap, preserves original inter-kernel gap, and keeps original M24; per-shape median-net fallback, not a per-invocation oracle. OA intra-kernel overlap is distinct from device-interface savings.

Graph is a traffic/shape projection on the 223 real frozen graph waves (both DP active); M24 OA falls back. Three residual rows are represented; MLA template is the median across 128 archived comparable 40-layer windows, not a same-wave kernel measurement. Both full DPs have fixed rank geometry and uniform assumed valid count. Ten partial waves bracket zero to physical-capacity SMLA change; aligned uses full capacity. Eager inputs and clock evidence are from the frozen 171 cohort. Baseline configuration predates the later repaired QLI/slot service.

Ordinary samples use each request’s own scheduled prompt geometry and verification count, archived stage-duration interpolation, its earlier/later causal request positions and two stock reference times. No separate ordinary timing of these fusions. B1 verification bounds allow the last sender to have zero useful sparse work. Changed resource contention, host submission readiness, graph replay scheduling, interactions with other workloads, numerical feasibility and validity of new layouts can change the outcome; the propagation and equal extra-cost gates quantify some of this sensitivity.
